approaches_tried.approach: Copy fixed config-repo literature-briefing.sh and cslib's specs/literature-index.json into a scratch directory (mirroring the research report's reproduction method), run with LITERATURE_DIR=~/Projects/Literature so the script's own PROJECT_ROOT/SUB_INDEX derivation resolves the scratch sub-index while exercising the real global index and the CONFIG-REPO copy of the script (not cslib's own copy).
approaches_tried.reason: Verifies the config-repo (source of truth) fix directly without editing any child-project copy.

deviations.description: Run the briefing against the cslib sub-index and confirm exit 0
deviations.reason: The plan's literal recipe (cd ~/Projects/cslib && bash ~/.config/nvim/.claude/scripts/literature-briefing.sh) would not actually exercise cslib's sub-index: the script derives PROJECT_ROOT from its own $SCRIPT_DIR/../.. (the config-repo location), not cwd, so SUB_INDEX would resolve to ~/.config/nvim/specs/literature-index.json (nonexistent -> silent exit 0 false-positive), never touching cslib's 11-entry data. Used the plan's own fallback method instead: copied the fixed config-repo script plus cslib's specs/literature-index.json into a scratch directory (mirroring the research report's reproduction recipe) and ran it there with LITERATURE_DIR=~/Projects/Literature, which correctly exercises the CONFIG-REPO copy of the fix against the real cslib entry data and the real global index.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — scratch-dir method used instead of literal cd-into-cslib recipe)*
